title: Tech Note: "Built to Order" Stores with 4D Business Kit

historical_commentary.text: 4D Business Kit has been discontinued for many years, and building a modern e-commerce storefront — built-to-order or otherwise — would today use current web frameworks, headless commerce platforms, or 4D's own modern web/ORDA/REST capabilities rather than this legacy all-in-one product, making the specific implementation obsolete though the general e-commerce concept remains evergreen.
related_updates: 4D Business Kit has been discontinued; modern e-commerce solutions built with 4D would use current web/ORDA/REST capabilities or dedicated third-party e-commerce platforms
